landing.sub: Ember is your personal digital library. Save videos, lectures, recipes, PDFs, and notes — and let AI watch, read, and remember everything for you.

video.title: Videos, first
video.body: Upload MP4s or paste YouTube, TikTok & Reels links.

ai.title: AI watches
ai.body: Transcripts, key moments, summaries, and tags — automatic.

library.title: Elegant library
library.body: Collections instead of folders. One item, many places.

chat.title: Chat with it
chat.body: Ask questions across everything you've ever saved.

auth.welcomeSubSignIn: Sign in to open your library.
auth.welcomeSubSignUp: A cozy place for everything you want to remember.
auth.notWorkingOpenNewTab: Google sign-in not working? Open in a new tab
auth.name: Name
auth.confirmInbox: Check your inbox to confirm your email.
auth.cookiesBlockedBody: Google sign-in can't complete inside this preview. We'll open it in a new tab, or you can sign in with email below.

library.title: Your library
library.emptyLead: Your quiet corner of the internet. Add something to begin.
library.emptyBody: Upload a video, paste a YouTube link, or drop in a PDF. Ember will read, watch, and remember everything.

upload.title: Add to your library
upload.sub: Upload a file, paste a link, or capture a quick note. Ember will do the rest.
upload.dropZone: Drop a file, or click to browse
upload.dropZoneHint: MP4, MOV, MP3, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, PNG — up to your storage plan
upload.linkHelp: Works with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and any web link.
upload.notePh: Type freely — Ember will summarize and tag it.

item.processing: Ember is understanding this item — transcript, summary, and tags coming up.
item.instagramNotice: Instagram limits automated fetching for Reels. Add a description and thumbnail below to help Ember (and future you) remember what this is.
item.relatedEmpty: Attach articles, videos, PDFs, or other library items that relate to this.
item.summaryUnavailable: Summary unavailable — try re-analyzing this item.

search.title: Search
search.sub: Ask in plain language. Ember looks across titles, transcripts, tags, and notes.
search.placeholder: e.g. the pasta recipe video, notes on empathy…
search.hint: Try “videos about leadership”, “recipe with chicken”, or “lecture about child development”.
search.noMatch: Nothing matched. Try different words, or ask Ember in chat.

chat.empty: Ask Ember anything about your library.
chat.welcomeSub: Ember only uses your library. It'll cite the items it references.
chat.promptExamples: Chat with your library. “Find every video about leadership.” “Summarize the psychology lectures.” “What did I save about active listening?”

settings.aiModelHint: Used for chat, summaries and auto-organize. Ember falls back to another provider if this one fails.

collections.name: Name
collections.descPh: A quiet corner of your library

collectionChat.title: Collection assistant
collectionChat.empty: Ask anything about the materials on this shelf — Ember reads across all of them.
collectionChat.thinking: Ember is reading through this shelf…
collectionChat.s4: Create study notes from everything here.

organize.reviewSub: Nothing changes until you approve it. Uncheck anything you'd rather keep as is.
organize.nothingToDo: Everything is already tidy — nothing new to organize.

export.partial_one: Export saved, but {{count}} file couldn't be downloaded.
export.partial_other: Export saved, but {{count}} files couldn't be downloaded.
export.hint: Your library belongs to you. The bundle contains every item, collection, tag, note, transcript and original file — ready to move anywhere.
